facts.business: AdCounty Media India Limited provides advertising services, operating in the AdTech and digital media space with a single reportable segment of service related to advertising.
key_risks: cyclical demand and pricing in principal markets
economic developments within India and outside the countries in which we conduct business
facts.related_party_note: Related parties include subsidiaries AdCounty Global Media LLC (wholly owned) and Adaxx Adtech & Media LLP (99.95% stake); entities where KMP/relatives have control: Athena Media Technologies Pte Ltd, Innovana Thinklabs Limited, Surfer Technologies Private Limited, Netsetgo Media Private Limited; KMP: Chandan Garg, Aditya Jangid, Abbhinav Rajendra Jain, Delphin Varghese, Vartika Dangayach, Ashita Agarwal, Garima Malik, Prakash Chand Gupta, Ujjval Sangtani, Pulkit Patel; close family members listed. Transactions include KMP remuneration (e.g., Chandan Garg ₹24.00 lakhs, Abbhinav Rajendra Jain ₹24.00 lakhs in FY2026).
